policy: Noncommercial research pilot. Public/candidate sources are not accepted training gold until GT, license, deduplication, and human review gates pass.

industryforge_mapping.paper: IndustryForge-27B: A Domain-Enhanced Multimodal Foundation Model for Industrial CAD
industryforge_mapping.evoCAD_extension: Keep the same foundation-model capability split, but bind every local sample to source receipts, verifiers, Kimi smoke status, and later human review.

families.label: Real engineering drawing QA
families.query_input: Full mechanical drawing image plus short or structured question; sometimes one boxed ROI.
families.output_target: JSON answer for line role, dimension attachment, dimension-chain, section, cross-view, or sufficiency.
families.verifier: json_fields with model-proposed labels; must remain diagnostic until human review accepts GT.

kimi_smoke.interpretation: Agreement with model-proposed labels, not accuracy against expert GT; all 18 diagnostic-eligible tasks now have a successful Kimi run when latest retries are considered.

families.risk: Good for Kimi failure-pattern discovery now; not fit for SFT/RL target labels until human review or authoritative drawing answers exist.

families.label: Generated drawing QA from verified BRep
families.query_input: Rendered orthographic drawing images generated from known STEP/BRep plus a perception or sufficiency question.
families.output_target: JSON answer for line role, dimension attachment, cross-view dimensions, projection diagnosis, or clarification.

local_artifacts.note: 20 mechanically checked tasks from 16 source parts

families.verifier: json_fields for QA; fixed-frame BRep for repair/reconstruction tasks.

kimi_smoke.interpretation: All 15 public-only Kimi perception tasks now have a successful run when latest retries are considered; geometry-code tasks are intentionally skipped by this smoke harness.

families.risk: Drawings are generated, not human engineering drawings; useful for controlled GT and negative controls.

families.label: Orthographic views and dimensions to 3D BRep
families.query_input: Three orthographic views and a dimension/specification sheet.
families.output_target: One STEP solid in the stated coordinate frame.
families.adapter: Reuse posttrain bundle layout; add code-execution learner sandbox before Kimi runs.
families.verifier: fixed-frame BRep missing/extra volume plus length/alignment tolerances.

kimi_smoke.interpretation: Current Kimi smoke only allows observe/conclude/submit JSON, not safe STEP-producing code execution.

families.risk: This is the core geometry-making benchmark; it needs a learner sandbox before model code is executed.

families.label: Text or render to CadQuery program
families.output_target: Executable CadQuery Python script plus rendered STEP/STL.

local_artifacts.note: Existing local adaptive/verifier skeleton; not a Text2CadQuery import

families.adapter: New importer should normalize source prompt, image, solution.py, rendered target.step, and sandbox receipt into the posttrain task layout.
families.verifier: Execute CadQuery in pinned env; compare target/candidate geometry using Chamfer and BRep checks where possible.

kimi_smoke.interpretation: Needs code-producing harness and timeout/resource policy.

families.risk: Dataset licenses, train/test leakage, and executable-code safety must be checked before import.

families.label: CAD software API action generation
families.query_input: CAD task text, optional UI screenshot or drawing, plus target CAD backend.
families.output_target: AutoCAD MCP / AutoLISP / COM-style operation trace that produces a CAD artifact.

local_artifacts.note: 20 deterministic CAD-action fixture tasks; not live AutoCAD/SolidWorks sessions

families.adapter: Wrap existing audited AutoCAD MCP jobs into posttrain Episode receipts; do not expose GT/private verifier to learner.
families.verifier: Native CAD execution receipt, topology export, structural checks, and geometry comparison.

kimi_smoke.interpretation: Should be run only after AutoCAD hang recovery and sandbox isolation are hardened.

families.risk: High value, but operationally fragile; needs watchdog/restart and deterministic job cleanup.

families.label: Assembly specification to constrained CAD assembly
families.query_input: Natural-language assembly requirement or structured part/interface specification.
families.output_target: Parametric parts plus assembly script/mates and interference-free assembled artifact.

local_artifacts.note: This registry records assembly as an import family
20 component-spec assembly seed tasks with final-BRep GT and reference assembly JSON

families.adapter: Importer should keep component graph, part files, transforms, mate/port schema, and collision checks separate from monolithic code.
families.verifier: All components present, port/mate constraints satisfied, no unacceptable interference, BRep-level part checks.

kimi_smoke.interpretation: Too early for Kimi smoke until representation and verifier are added.

families.risk: Assembly data is the least covered locally but important for publishable long-horizon CAD claims.

families.label: Verifier-feedback repair and self-reflection
families.query_input: Initial wrong CAD artifact, public drawing/spec, verifier feedback, and trajectory history.
families.output_target: Corrected artifact plus structured reflection/action decision.
families.adapter: Use existing adaptive protocol and run ledger; store every verifier result in trajectory events.
families.verifier: Same task verifier as source task; reward shaping must be separate from acceptance.

kimi_smoke.interpretation: Needs code execution and iterative feedback loop, not the perception-only smoke harness.

families.risk: Useful for RL/environment work, but only after verifier feedback is rich enough to localize repairable errors.

families.label: CAD to mesh, simulation setup, and post-processing
families.query_input: Paper/specification figures and text, target CAD/mesh/simulation requirements.
families.output_target: CAD geometry, mesh/solver setup, verification report, and post-processing evidence.
families.adapter: Keep this as long-horizon eval, not mixed into short CAD-VQA SFT until stage labels are separated.
families.verifier: Geometry checks, mesh checks, solver/log checks, and report consistency checks.

kimi_smoke.interpretation: Existing runs are case studies; no 20-30 sample batch yet.

families.risk: Publishable direction, but expensive and heterogeneous; should not block the core CAD post-training set.
